On this week's Jeopardy, the first contestant was a lawyer, the second contestant was a janitor, and the third contestant's profession wasn't revealed. The janitor quickly outpaced both of the other contestants, and the lawyer did the worst, only getting two questions right. Who lost Jeopardy?
A. Can't answer
B. The janitor
C. The lawyer
